big_picture.title: Stock Market Races Higher; Nasdaq Jumps Nearly 3% As Chip Stocks Fly, Leave Nvidia In The Dust
big_picture.excerpt: The stock market soared Monday as chip stocks rallied even as Nvidia shares sold off on CEO Jensen Huang's scandal.
paragraphs: The major stock indexes kicked off the week with robust gains as technology stocks shrugged off a sell-off in Nvidia (NVDA) shares. Instead, money flowed out of oil and into other Nasdaq-100 chip stocks like Advanced Micro Devices (AMD), Monolithic Power Systems (MPWR) and Astera Labs (ALAB).

Monday's session helped push the Nasdaq composite above its 200-day moving average. It gained 2.7% in lower volume by the close. It was a small victory for the composite, which still has plenty of other potential resistance levels to conquer. The index is still below its 10-day, 21-day and 50-day lines after pulling back 12% off its recent high.
